lines.text: Do you want to hang out this weekend?

data.define: To spend free time with someone without a special plan.

example.text: Do you want to hang out this weekend?

misuse.text: Don't invite your boss to 'hang out' formally.
misuse.why: It sounds too casual for work.

publish.title: What does "hang out" mean?
publish.value: Hang out = Spend relaxed time with friends. Example: "Do you want to hang out this weekend?" (casual English).
